defective_pattern: Using naive character-length filtering (e.g., len > X) to identify and extract bibliographic references from raw text.
why_defective: Length-only heuristics fail to distinguish actual references from non-reference text like long subheadings, paragraph fragments, or appendices. This causes non-reference text leakage into the master thesis bibliography, corrupting the final artifact.
observed_symptoms: Subheadings appearing as reference entries in the bibliography.
Non-reference text leakage in the bibliography.
Invalid reference formatting or parsing failures downstream.
corrective_remedy: Implement robust structural parsing using regex patterns that match specific citation components (e.g., publication year in parentheses, DOI links, standard APA 7 formatting) or use a dedicated reference parser rather than character count.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Regex detecting document subheadings appearing as reference items.
